name: Bebê

story: Recolhe-se numa cápsula de escamas e retém pequenas cargas.

story: Desenrola o corpo e testa pequenas descargas entre as garras.

name: Jovem
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL YOUNG intermediate stage of the supplied own CHILD thunder pangolin family. This MUST look between child and adult, NOT another large fully armored dragon. Full complete three-quarter on WHITE, generous margins. A lean medium-size upright PANGOLIN adolescent, TWO moderately long hind legs and TWO longer slim forearms, THREE modest ivory curved digging hooks each forehand, three short ivory toes each hind foot. Tail thick enough for balance but only HALF body height, tapering, curves beside legs. Head about one fifth figure height, slim cream PANGOLIN tapered toothless snout, small violet nose, narrower thoughtful VIOLET eyes than child, exactly TWO modest flat cyan brow scale points with yellow fork seam, NO dragon horns, elaborate crown, wings or fin fans. The child starts round; this young grows taller and leaner, an athlete learning to control charge. Deep violet living body, cream throat/abdomen, only FOUR LARGE BLUE/CYAN overlapping PAPER SCALE shields running from top of head down spine, TWO scaled shoulder flaps remain folded FLUSH against back, NOT opening into wings, and just THREE large scales on tail. Slim arms have ONE narrow cyan forearm brace each rather than giant adult gauntlets, small orange wrist knots and TWO simple golden bamboo edges supporting the scale. Chest SMALL IVORY KITE MEMBRANE with one slender branching violet seam, two warm golden ribs, not massive broad armored torso. Deliberate cautious pose one hooked forehand held near chest, the other extended palm diagonally down, knees slightly bent; all four limb connections obvious, no fifth paw. ONE small YELLOW zigzag spark between fingertips and one purple cord line on forearm, no immense lightning halo. Tail ends in orange soul-rabiola cord with TWO violet/ivory short lightning-shaped pennants. This stage learns to open ONE scale edge a little to vent charge, simple living kite anatomy and relaxed empty areas remain. No armor skirt, belly plates, huge biceps, giant claws, wings, spikes, real metal or full dragon adult silhouette. Preserve family crisp original 2D MANGA with broad clean color fields, ONE flat base + ONE hard cel shadow, dark ink, no gradients/shiny rubber/texture/scratches/crumpled origami/excess tiny scales/text/scenery. Reference child supplies direct identity; new young clearly grows above it without reaching adult size or equipment.
story: Ganha alcance e controle sem abrir a proteção: aprende a conduzir carga até as mãos.

story: A rota quadrúpede concentra peso, apoio e condução pelas garras; pequenos leques orientam a descarga.

TWO short swept lightning-fork crown plates form original angular crown from overlapping scales, not huge horns. Three broad cheek scale tips, no fluffy mane. Body warm DEEP VIOLET flexible understructure and cream throat, covered in FEW LARGE overlapping COBALT BLUE and ELECTRIC CYAN kite-shaped PANGOLIN SCALES, just THREE broad bands at shoulders and SIX broad tail rows, no hundreds of tiny repeated scales. Exactly TWO short flat yellow zigzag arcs between shoulder tips and forearm conductor edges, enough to identify THUNDER, no huge aura obscuring structure. FOREARMS blue/cyan with big smooth long scale shields and cream underside, claws natural robust digging hooks not copied metal gauntlet blades. Wide planted stance, one forearm opened palm forward, other braced near chest, all joints and paws clear. ONE orange soul-rabiola cord grows from LAST TAIL SCALE knot into TWO violet/ivory lightning-shaped PAPER pennants, full attachment and ends visible. Adult story: opens protective pangolin shell into lightning-routing kite shield, gathers and redirects storms, not a collage of existing monsters. Original precise CLEAN 2D MANGA monster ink, ONE FLAT BASE COLOR + ONE HARD CEL SHADOW per material, no gradients/specular shine/scratches/realistic metallic texture/crumpled paper/tiny ornaments/lettering/scenery.
